channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Influência do identitarismo está no fim, diz Antonio Risério
item.description: Writer and anthropologist Antonio Risério claims that identity politics is losing influence in society and left-wing politics, arguing it contradicts classical Marxism and has become an electoral burden. He attributes part of its decline in the U.S. to Hillary Clinton’s 2016 defeat and sees a similar pattern emerging in Brazil, where the movement was imported and is now waning. Risério, a former Lula supporter in 2006 who now criticizes the PT, identifies as a 'democratic leftist' and released his book 'Goodbye, Identity Politics' in May 2026.

item.title: Fim da 6 X 1 está parada há 1 mês e sem perspectiva de avanço
item.description: The PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, approved by the Chamber on May 27, remains stalled in the Senate without a set schedule for CCJ review. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre advocates for a longer analysis with sectoral hearings, delaying approval before the July 18 congressional recess and creating tension with the Lula government.

item.title: Flávio ou Michelle?
item.description: A poll of 687 Metrópoles readers shows 71.8% favor Michelle Bolsonaro as the future leader of Bolsonarist right-wing politics after the October 2026 elections, compared to 28.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The result indicates a strong preference among Bolsonaro’s base for Michelle as Jair Bolsonaro’s political successor.

item.title: Flávio visita o pai, mas não vira a página com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in Brasília and claimed that his disagreement with Michelle had been overcome, using the metaphor of 'turning the page' and wearing a white peace shirt. Despite asserting reconciliation, he did not confirm whether he spoke with Michelle, fueling speculation about the motives behind her public criticisms, possibly tied to the unexplained use of R$ 61 million donated by Daniel Vorcaro for a film glorifying the Bolsonaro clan, with the promised 30-day financial report still outstanding.

item.title: Brasil já registrou mais de 70 casos de assédio eleitoral em 2026, diz MPT
item.description: Brazil has recorded 71 cases of electoral harassment in 2026, according to data from the Labor Public Prosecutor's Office (MPT) as of April 24. The complaints involve employers or supervisors pressuring employees to vote for a specific candidate. The MPT warns that such practices constitute electoral crimes and violations of labor rights.

item.title: "Eu quero é distância desse povo, tá bom?", diz motorista de Vorcaro
item.description: Sidney Santos, a driver for Daniel Vorcaro, said he wanted 'distance from these people' when questioned about his role, which involved delivering documents related to two environmental bills to Senator Ciro Nogueira. Federal Police identified him as part of a bribery scheme where the senator allegedly received illicit payments to advance Vorcaro’s interests in Congress. The bills — the Paten program and the carbon credit market — were approved despite partial vetoes, with support from lawmakers like Jaques Wagner.

item.title: Lula tenta destravar palanque em MG, mas enfrenta disputa interna no PT
item.description: The Minas Gerais PT is experiencing an internal dispute over whether Marília Campos should run for governor or Senate, with her advocating for a broad front including MDB, PSB, and PDT. President Lula and the national PT leadership are pressuring her to abandon her Senate bid and run for governor, but she insists on her Senate candidacy. This deadlock is stalling Lula’s campaign strategy in Minas Gerais, a key state for the 2026 election.

item.title: Republicanos já não garante que Cleitinho dê palanque a Flávio em MG
item.description: The president of the Republicans in Minas Gerais, Euclydes Pettersen, does not guarantee that Senator Cleitinho Azevedo will provide a campaign platform for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections, even if Cleitinho decides to run. He emphasized that Cleitinho will maintain his independent positions, including support for Michelle Bolsonaro and votes aligned with Lula’s government, which may cause friction with the bolsonarist faction. The party is evaluating options for a standalone candidacy in Minas Gerais amid Flávio’s declining poll numbers.

item.title: Cláusula de barreira ameaça esvaziar caixa de PSol, Novo e Missão
item.description: The 2026 performance clause requires parties to obtain 2.5% of valid national votes for federal deputy (with 1.5% in nine states) or elect 13 deputies across nine federative units, threatening access to the Party Fund and mandatory TV/radio time for parties like Novo, Missão, and PSol. Novo, which elected only three federal deputies in 2022, aims to expand its caucus with competitive candidates, while Missão, in its first election, relies on grassroots activism and social media. PSol is attempting to broaden its geographic presence to meet the thresholds.

item.title: A um mês das convenções, presidenciáveis negociam vice pensando em reduzir resistências do eleitorado e em tempo de TV
item.description: Less than a month before the 2026 party conventions, presidential candidates are negotiating vice-presidential picks to reduce voter resistance and gain more TV time through coalition-building. Flávio Bolsonaro is seeking a woman to appeal to female voters, while Lula has confirmed repeating his 2022 ticket with Geraldo Alckmin, citing discretion, loyalty, and competence. Political scientist Carlos Ranulfo explains that the vice primarily serves as a signal to broaden the party's appeal rather than directly adding votes.

item.title: De la Espriella llega alineado con sus vecinos, a excepción de Lula
item.description: Colombian president-elect Abelardo de la Espriella announced diplomatic alignment with Donald Trump's United States, including immediate accession to the 'Shield of the Americas', a Trump-backed initiative framed as a counter-narcotics alliance. He explicitly rejected alignment with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, maintaining ideological distance.

item.title: Lula e novo presidente da Colômbia devem ter relação pragmática, avalia diplomacia do Brasil
item.description: The election of Abelardo de la Espriella as Colombia's new president was welcomed by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who emphasized the importance of bilateral ties in addressing shared challenges. Brazilian diplomats anticipate a pragmatic cooperation focused on infrastructure, energy, organized crime, and natural disasters, independent of ideological alignment. The result strengthens the right-wing trend across South America, leaving Lula as one of the few leftist leaders in the continent's major economies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se ausentou em 43% das votações nominais do Senado este ano
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) missed 43% of nominal Senate votes in 2026, according to a Folha de S.Paulo survey. He tied with four other senators as the fifth-highest absentee, failing to vote in 21 of 49 measures analyzed through June 22.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro nega ‘falta grave’ em apreensão de arma e pede manutenção da domiciliar
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes not to classify the seizure of a firearm in his name as a 'serious violation,' requesting the continuation of house arrest. They argue the weapon was legally registered, removed for repair, and not concealed, with no intent to evade judicial oversight. The Prosecutor General's Office has already weighed in, and the STF will determine whether the incident constitutes a breach of the Penal Execution Law, which could lead to the revocation of house arrest privileges.

item.title: “Atenta contra toda a sociedade”, diz Tarcísio sobre ataque contra tenente da Rota
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas described the attack on Rota lieutenant Ronickson Pimentel dos Santos as a crime against society. The officer was shot in the head in São Caetano do Sul, remains in critical condition, and underwent surgery. He is the brother of Eloá Cristina Pimentel, who was murdered in 2008.

item.title: Senador, deputado e presidente: quais as funções de cada um
item.description: The CNT/MDA poll shows 60.5% of Brazilians don’t recall whom they voted for in legislative offices in 2022, even as 58.4% intend to renew their vote in the 2026 elections. With the first round set for October 4, understanding the distinct roles of the President of the Republic (head of the Executive, with veto power and command of the Armed Forces), federal deputies (proportional representatives in the Chamber, responsible for laws and budget), and senators (fixed representation per state in the Federal Senate) is crucial. The National Congress, comprising 513 deputies and 81 senators, drafts laws and oversees the Executive.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede que Moraes descarte falta grave por posse de arma
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro requested that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes dismiss the possibility of recognizing a serious offense in the case of a firearm registered in the former president's name. Lawyers also asked for an extension of the humanitarian house arrest granted in March. The request aims to avoid harsher penalties in the ongoing legal proceedings.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro diz que arma apreendida não é 'falta grave'
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro denied that the former president committed a 'serious offense' in the case of the seized weapon, arguing that the seizure does not constitute a serious infraction. The argument was submitted to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF in response to ongoing investigations.

item.title: Tarcísio cobra prisão de autores dos disparos contra tenente da Rota
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas responded after Rota lieutenant Ronickson Pimentel dos Santos was shot in the head at a traffic light in São Caetano do Sul, calling it an attempted homicide and ordering maximum priority for security forces to identify and arrest the perpetrators. He expressed solidarity with the victim’s family and fellow officers, stressed that attacks on police are attacks on society, and vowed full legal rigor. The lieutenant is the brother of Eloá Pimentel, who was killed in a 2008 kidnapping.

item.title: STF forma maioria para liberar parte do pagamento dos penduricalhos a juízes e promotores
item.description: The STF formed a majority to authorize partial payment of 'penduricalhos' (extra benefits) for judges, prosecutors, and attorneys, including retroactive payments, time-in-service bonuses, and judiciary duty/guard duty pay, provided they do not exceed 35% of the constitutional subsidy ceiling (R$ 46.366,19). The ruling follows the joint vote of ministers Flávio Dino, Gilmar Mendes, Alexandre de Moraes, and Cristiano Zanin, with support from Luiz Fux, who argues for full payment of indemnity parcels but maintains the 35% cap. Abono de permanência, election bonuses, health aid, and ATS are also permitted within this limit, and the CNJ and CNMP will set daily planton values.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que briga com Michelle é ‘página virada’ e indica interesse em vice mulher
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his public disagreement with Michelle Bolsonaro is 'water under the bridge' and reiterated his interest in having a woman as his vice-presidential running mate, citing Ana Paula Rezende as an example of qualification. He emphasized the need for unity within the PL and clarified that he had spoken with Jair Bolsonaro, saying everything is 'fine'.

item.title: Orçamento mais baixo que rivais faz Renan Santos viver aventura e perrengue na Amazônia
item.description: Renan Santos, the pre-candidate of the Missão party for the Brazilian presidency, faced multiple setbacks during his Amazon trip, including a flight delay of over 10 hours, a broken boat, and having to improvise a live interview using a phone propped on a Toddy box and a water bottle as a tripod — all symptoms of a campaign operating on a much tighter budget than his rivals’. Despite the chaos, he continued his schedule, recording riverine experiences and demonstrating perseverance, which his allies praise as a sign of authenticity and grassroots strength in a campaign run 'on the soles of the shoes'.

item.title: O duelo que decidirá o destino do escândalo do Banco Master
item.description: The Banco Master scandal, under investigation by the Federal Police, exposed alleged illicit advantages received by authorities including Senator Jaques Wagner (PT), former Rio Governor Cláudio Castro (PL), and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), damaging their political careers and electoral prospects. The case also reached the Supreme Court (STF), revealing million-dollar deals between the scheme and companies linked to Ministers Dias Toffoli and Alexandre de Moraes, alongside accusations of efforts to obstruct investigations through procedural nullities. The Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro electoral clash is now shaped by the scandal, which is influencing public perception ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança ao lado de Valdemar Costa Neto pré-candidaturas do PL em Goiás
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential pre-candidate, launched the PL's pre-candidacies in Goiás alongside national party president Valdemar Costa Neto. The event featured support for Wilder Morais (governor pre-candidate), Delegado Humberto Teófilo (Novo) and Ozéias Varão (PL) for the Senate, along with praise for Wilder’s running mate, Ana Paula Rezende. Flávio emphasized party unity and avoided mentioning tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro, reinforcing a narrative of political cohesion.

item.title: Aplicativo: governo emite série de alertas sobre roubo de celulares
item.description: The federal government issued a series of WhatsApp alerts about the Celular Seguro (Secure Cellphone) program, targeting users in high-theft regions to verify IMEI numbers before purchasing devices and to register theft or loss in the National Bank of Restricted Cellphones (BNCR). The alerts, signed by Gov.br, emphasize that IMEI verification is part of a new phase of the program established by decree from President Lula, aiming to reduce post-theft banking fraud by enabling remote blocking of phone lines and banking apps through the program’s app.

item.title: Carta revela que Flávio Bolsonaro ofereceu “equipe de transição” aos EUA se vencer eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed in a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio that, if elected president in October, he would make his transition team available to the United States to negotiate a broad bilateral trade and investment agreement. Rubio’s letter thanked the offer and noted the senator’s optimism about the election. Brazilian law stipulates that the transition team is only formed after the election results are finalized.

item.title: O barraco de Michelle e o rolo Master de Wagner contam como o país funciona
item.description: A recent video by Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady, sparked controversy by promoting a new far-right narrative, potentially influencing the 2026 election by drawing supporters who might otherwise back Flávio Bolsonaro. The content suggests a strategy of ideological polarization aimed at consolidating a parallel base to the official Bolsonaro movement, risking fragmentation within the conservative electorate. Its electoral relevance lies in the intra-right competition for votes in a tightly contested race.

item.title: Valdemar defende Flávio e diz que Bolsonaro o escolheu
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto defended Flávio Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate for 2026, stating he was chosen by Jair Bolsonaro. The comment followed a public clash between Flávio and his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused him of disrespect and exclusion from party decisions. Flávio called for party unity, while Michelle said she no longer speaks to him after the phone call.

item.title: Marília reforça desejo ao Senado e defende aliança com PSB e MDB
item.description: Marília Campos, PT’s pre-candidate for the Senate, stated she resigned as mayor of Contagem under the condition of running for the Senate and is currently negotiating an alliance with PSB, MDB, and possibly PDT to form a broad front in Minas Gerais. She argues this unity is essential to compete strongly for the Palácio Tiradentes and views the decision to run a standalone candidacy as a mistake. National PT president Edinho Silva will visit Minas to meet with her, while state PT leaders support her for governor, though she resists that option.

item.title: Assembleias de SP, CE, AL e SE liberam autopromoção de deputados às vésperas de eleições
item.description: Four state legislative assemblies (SP, CE, AL, SE) allow deputies to use public funds for self-promotion on social media even in the months preceding elections, unlike the federal Chamber of Deputies and most other states. This loophole creates a competitive advantage for incumbent politicians, as the use of the parliamentary quota for disseminating their activities can boost their candidacies without explicit restriction, although experts warn that the lack of a specific rule hinders accountability for potential abuses.

item.title: Rubio agradece convite de Flávio para equipe de transição se eleito
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio thanked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for offering to make a transition team available to the U.S. government if elected president in October. Rubio affirmed the United States’ readiness to cooperate with Brazil’s future leadership on broad, fair, and mutually beneficial trade and investment agreements. He also noted that, under Brazilian law, a transition team can only be formed after the election results are finalized.

item.title: Flávio volta a falar em união depois de atrito público com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) called for unity among Bolsonarists after a public clash with his stepmother Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused him of disrespecting her over his support for Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in Ceará. He stressed that the 2026 election is about Brazil’s future over the next 50 years, not just Bolsonaro or Lula, and advocated lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reafirma preferência por vice “qualificada”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated his preference for a qualified woman as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 presidential race, speaking at a PL event in Goiânia. The statement came days after a public disagreement with Michelle Bolsonaro, the former first lady, and included praise for Ana Paula, though her full name was not specified. He emphasized that the vice-presidential pick would be based on competence and ideological alignment.

item.title: Quem realmente estará ao nível do Presidente Lula para disputar as eleições 2026 ? Comente!
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential race has not yet produced a clear frontrunner to challenge Lula, though names like Ciro Gomes, João Doria, Sergio Moro, and Tarcísio de Freitas are frequently mentioned as potential contenders. The political landscape remains fluid, heavily influenced by economic performance, government popularity, and possible party alliances. So far, no candidate has built sufficient national support to be considered Lula’s equal in terms of reach and organizational strength.

item.title: O desconforto do PT com a prisão de vereador do partido em São Paulo
item.description: The arrest of PT councilman Senival Moura in Operation Última Parada exposes an alleged money laundering scheme linked to the PCC via the bus company Transunião, raising suspicions about the financing of PT campaigns in São Paulo. Investigators suggest criminal faction funds may have irrigated Fernando Haddad’s gubernatorial bid and bolstered Lula’s national project, though no direct evidence yet ties the party leaders to the scheme. The case creates discomfort within the PT, threatening to link the party to criminal structures in public transport — a strategic sector for its electoral base.

item.title: Flávio reforça expectativa de mulher na chapa e diz querer vice qualificada e disposta a colaborar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for President of Brazil, stated in Goiânia that he hopes to have a vice-presidential running mate as qualified as the woman chosen by the party for the Goiás gubernatorial ticket. He reinforced the expectation of female inclusion on the presidential ticket and emphasized the need for a collaborative and well-prepared partner.

item.title: Em meio à crise, Valdemar diz que Flávio foi escolhido por Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was chosen by Jair Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate for 2026, emphasizing that the former president does not make mistakes in his choices. The remark was made during the launch of the PL's majoritarian pre-candidacies in Goiás, without referencing the rift between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Como o ex-deputado Daniel Silveira pode atrapalhar uma eventual anistia a Bolsonaro
item.description: Former deputy Daniel Silveira presents a significant legal obstacle to any amnesty attempt for Jair Bolsonaro, as the Supreme Federal Court annulled in 2023 the presidential pardon granted to Silveira by Bolsonaro, establishing that no pardon can erase attacks on the Rule of Law. Legal experts and constitutionalists argue that amnesties aiming to 'forget' the January 8 events violate the 1988 Constitution, as they undermine the guarantee of non-repetition and weaken the Rule of Law, regardless of the target.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro define briga com Michelle como 'página virada'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that his disagreement with his stepmother, Michelle Bolsonaro, is a resolved matter, describing it as a 'page turned'. He attributed the tension to stress from his father Jair Bolsonaro's health issues and emphasized his focus on the presidential pre-campaign. The senator took part in a pilgrimage in Goiânia and avoided confirming whether he had direct contact with Michelle after the incident.

item.title: O que faz Cleitinho segurar o embarque do Republicanos na pré-candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Cleitinho, a Republicanos senator and potential Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate, is resisting announcing his candidacy alongside Flávio Bolsonaro, as party sources believe Flávio needs Cleitinho’s support more than Cleitinho needs Bolsonaro’s. This dynamic is delaying the party’s alignment with Flávio’s presidential pre-candidacy, especially given polls showing 30% of voters support a Cleitinho-Lula ticket.

item.title: Roberto Reis na Crusoé: O primeiro eleitorado pós-Lula
item.description: The June Datafolha poll shows Lula leading with 41% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 31% in the first round, but the author argues the real significance lies not in Lula’s lead, but in the electorate that won’t mourn his potential defeat — signaling a post-Lula voter base that is more fragmented and less emotionally tied to the PT.

item.title: Jaques Wagner volta a defender inocência e cita fala de Lula: 'só quem sabe o que você fez é você'
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) reiterated his innocence regarding suspicions tied to a Federal Police operation investigating payments linked to Daniel Vorcaro's Banco Master, calling the accusations lies. He quoted a statement attributed to Lula: 'only you know what you did,' to stress that only he knows the truth about his own actions.

item.title: STF tem maioria para liberar penduricalhos retroativos
item.description: The STF has formed a majority of 6 votes to authorize retroactive payment of 'penduricalhos', including accumulated vacation, prize leave, and on-duty shifts prior to the March ruling, provided they are indenizatory and capped at 35% of the constitutional ceiling. The Court also approved immediate payment of the career seniority valuation parcel (PV TAC), reinstating the quinquennium system, while replacing fixed monthly health allowances with a reimbursement model requiring proof of expenses. Ministers are now reviewing appeals regarding alleged omissions and ambiguities in the March decision, which had initially capped benefits at 35% of the ceiling plus an additional 35% as a service-time gratuity.

item.title: Jorginho Mello rebate críticas de Lula: “Ele não entrega nada”
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) rebutted President Lula's criticisms, claiming the president 'delivers nothing' to the state and denying he had refused federal investments, asserting Lula fails to fulfill promises during his visits.

item.title: A segunda batalha de Carla Zambelli para tentar evitar extradição para o Brasil
item.description: Former deputy Carla Zambelli, sentenced to five years and three months in prison for illegal weapon possession and illegal constraint after chasing a man with a gun on the eve of the 2022 presidential election runoff, fled to Italy. The Brazilian government is seeking her extradition for this case, following the rejection of the first request — related to hacking the National Justice Council’s computers — by Italy’s Court of Cassation, which ruled that Minister Alexandre de Moraes improperly served as both judge and victim. Zambelli’s lawyer expects the second request to also be denied, while the STF and Italian legal scholars maintain the Brazilian proceedings were lawful.

item.title: Flávio e PL de Goiás lançam candidaturas em evento de apoio mútuo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended an event in Goiânia to launch the PL's majoritarian candidacies in the state, alongside gubernatorial pre-candidate Wilder Morais. He was honored with awards and greeted by conservative supporters, signaling strength for the Bolsonarist project, despite family tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro and controversies over his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A crítica de rival de Jaques sobre postura de petista após ser alvo de operação da PF
item.description: João Roma, former minister and Senate rival of Jaques Wagner, criticized Wagner's posture after being targeted by PF's Compliance Zero operation, saying his attempt to normalize the allegations damaged his image more than the investigation itself. Roma called it a 'scandal' and 'shame' that Wagner likened a banker buying an apartment for his daughter to buying a popsicle at the beach. Wagner stepped down from Senate government leadership six days after the operation, following a talk with Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro associa PCC ao PT depois de prisão de vereador
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) linked the Workers' Party (PT) to the PCC following the arrest of São Paulo city councilor Senival Moura (PT), accusing the party of ties to a multimillion-dollar organized crime scheme and claiming Lula protected criminal factions. He also reiterated his call for the U.S. to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, referencing the MPSP's Operation Última Parada, which seized R$ 194 million and arrested Moura on money laundering suspicions via a bus company.

item.title: Marília Campos elogia nomes do MDB e PSB e falará com Lula contra candidatura do PT em MG
item.description: Marília Campos, former mayor of Contagem and PT member, once again rejected pressure from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the PT to run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026. She publicly praised figures from MDB and PSB as viable alternatives, signaling her support for a non-PT candidacy. This move highlights growing internal party tension over the PT’s candidate selection in MG.

item.title: Empiricus manda vender ações de banco que defendeu Lula
item.description: Empiricus, the analysis arm of BTG Pactual, issued a report advising the sale of BR Partners shares one day after its CEO, Ricardo Lacerda, stated that Lula’s re-election does not pose institutional risk, but a potential victory by Flávio Bolsonaro could. The recommendation was exclusive to subscribers.
